source: Toussaint, PhD thesis, Ruhr-Universitaet Bochum, sections 1.5.3-1.5.4
substrate: variable-length symbol string with rewrite operators, 25-symbol phenotype
machinery_note: DECISIVE DEFECT: beta=0 populations cannot construct rewrite operators at all. One arm was permitted a class of machinery the other was not.
future_distribution_how: Monte Carlo, 2000 offspring per individual per generation, population-wide, both probe settings on the same frozen population
conditioned_result: FAILED. Current best fitness predicted subsequent gain at least as well as every accessibility statistic. K7 fired.
surviving_artifacts: 16 hashed publications + 6 code artifacts + 324 run files, herakles/specimens/spec-toussaint-exploration/
confounds: machinery-presence asymmetry
detector/outcome coupling, a property of the whole experimental family per the Ergon lane
H_level_note: H2 established at 24 to 108 times estimator noise, including at identical phenotype and identical fitness. H3 NOT established. H4 not attempted.

source: Kounios, Clune, Kouvaris, Wagner, Pavlicev, Weinreich, Watson, arXiv 1612.05955
substrate: gene regulatory network, 16 real genes, recurrent development
machinery_note: SHARES HC-T01's DEFECT. The ablation is a one-to-one genotype-phenotype map against an evolving GRN. Turning development off is turning off the machinery that biases variation. Not a cure for our confound.
identical_variation_note: verified by the Ergon lane: a single randomly chosen trait of G is mutated every step by adding a uniform draw in plus or minus 0.1, identical in both arms
future_distribution_how: GLOBAL, not local: developmental basin of attraction, the number of G vectors mapping to the target phenotype, tracked over 1600 evolutionary episodes
surviving_artifacts: arXiv PDF; author code exists per the Ergon lane under handle variants
confounds: same machinery-presence asymmetry as HC-T01
basin detector measured in a single unablated condition, so the composition is not assembled
H_level_note: the accessibility quantity is a global pre-image size, not a same-probe one-step neighbourhood, and it is not measured in the ablated arm
relation_to_HC_T01: CLOSEST SIBLING. Predates the HC-T01 directive by four months and was invisible to this seat's descendants search, which was seeded on Toussaint's citation graph.

source: Tiso, PhD thesis chapter 3, 'The evolution of mutational transformers', University of Groningen, defended 23 January 2024
substrate: gene regulatory network with varying architecture and transfer function
machinery_note: arms are GRN architecture crossed with transfer function, with environment and selection HELD FIXED. This is a representational manipulation and NOT selection-side, which is rare and valuable. Whether the arms count as the same machinery class is the open question for HC-R01: architecture is assigned, not evolved, so the difference may be design-conditioned rather than history-conditioned.
future_distribution_how: A-LOCAL: 1000 mutations at each locus of the best-performing GRN at a given time point, per the Ergon lane's direct quotation from page 67
confounds: the detector is NOT run in the negative-control arm, the trivial network where time-to-adaptation does not improve; a detector absent from the control arm cannot support a contrast
the within-run link is descriptive, n=1, a representative simulation, with no statistic relating detector state at t to time-to-adaptation at t+n
never published
H_level: H2 established, H3 attempted but descriptive
H_level_note: the nearest thing to HC-T01 that exists anywhere per the Ergon lane. Its three defects are exactly what leaves HC-T01 a rigour cell.
relation_to_HC_T01: SUPERSEDES HC-T01's missing-cell claim about the wider literature. Missed by this seat.

source: Petak et al., 'The variability of evolvability: Properties of dynamic fitness landscapes determine how phenotypic variation evolves', PNAS, PMC12745803
machinery_note: STRONGEST FEATURE FOR HC-R01: the intervention is static versus variable environment. Both arms have identical genomes, identical machinery and an identical mutation operator, and differ ONLY in environmental history. This is the machinery-matched case HC-T01 could not supply.
identical_variation_note: verified quotation via the Ergon lane: offspring were generated with the same mutation operation used in the evolutionary runs
future_distribution_how: A-LOCAL with the REAL operator: 2500 clones for robustness, 10000 mutated clones for phenotypic variability, longitudinal across environmental changes
conditioned_note: OPEN AND HIGH VALUE: the predictor relationship is a correlation across the 15 landscape pairs. Whether it survives conditioning on current fitness is, as far as we know, untested. If the raw data survive this is a cheap HCA-2 test on published data.
surviving_artifacts: PNAS open access, Europe PMC full-text XML; data availability unassessed by this seat
reconstruction_feasibility: UNASSESSED; possibly unnecessary if raw data survive
confounds: selection-side intervention, so it does not test an operator-side mechanism
arm-level rather than within-run acquisition link
H_level: H2 established with proper replication, H3 arm-level only
H_level_note: strictly stronger than Kouvaris 2017 on the detector and its longitudinality, and properly replicated with 95 percent CIs over 15 replicates
relation_to_HC_T01: THE MACHINERY-MATCHED ANALOGUE. Highest-priority follow-up for HC-R01 question 2. Missed by this seat.

source: EvCA programme, six genomes recovered and verified by execution; 13 hashed publications
substrate: 1D binary cellular automaton, radius 3, 128-entry rule table, density classification
machinery_note: BEST AVAILABLE ON THIS AXIS. Every rule is a 128-entry binary table under the same bit-flip operator. No arm can build machinery another cannot. The HC-T01 confound cannot arise.
history_note: particle1 and particle2 come from DIFFERENT genetic-algorithm runs and sit 0.009 to 0.013 apart in measured performance: a naturally occurring matched-performance pair with different histories
future_distribution_how: NOT YET. But the one-step neighbourhood is EXACTLY 128 rules and is fully enumerable, so the detector needs no Monte Carlo estimate of which variants exist.
surviving_artifacts: herakles/specimens/spec-evca-density/, six genomes verified by execution, rule tables re-derived from first principles matching all 32 published hex digits for two calibration rules
reconstruction_feasibility: GATE-1 ALREADY OPEN for this specimen
confounds: cannot separate history from location on the six recovered genomes, because rule-table content is part of the present state; see EVCA_HCA1_HCA2_DESIGN_NOTE.md section 3
H_level: H0 as it stands; H1 and H2 reachable by Stage 0 archaeology alone
relation_to_HC_T01: THE INTENDED SECOND SUBSTRATE. Design note written, run NOT authorised.

source: Petak, Frati, Vroomans, Pespeni, Cheney, 'The variability of evolvability', PNAS doi 10.1073/pnas.2519469122; preprint bioRxiv 10.1101/2025.07.02.662714 read in full
substrate: recurrent gene-regulatory-network genome developing a spatiotemporal expression pattern across a ring of cells, selected against patterns generated by elementary cellular automata rules; 105 rule/initial-condition pairs, 15 used in detail
present_state_note: the comparison conditions on the population's OWN current highest-fitness genotype immediately before an environment switch, rather than imposing an external fitness match across lineages
machinery_note: DECISIVE. Static- and variable-environment populations evolve the identical GRN architecture, the identical mutation rule and the identical selection algorithm. Only the environment-switching schedule differs. This is the machinery-matched case HC-T01 could not supply.
identical_variation_note: offspring mutated at G*m positions by adding N(0,0.5) noise, and the SAME operator is reused for the accessibility sampling
future_distribution_how: 2500 clones mutated for robustness measures; 10000 mutated clones for phenotypic variability across cells and developmental steps; applied to evolved genotypes with the real operator
causal_intervention: PARTIAL. Two decomposition experiments inject random mutation, or a random target, every 300 generations, 5 runs on each of 15 landscapes. These perturb the ONGOING process; there is no reset-the-evolved-organisation-and-remeasure ablation, so the strict H4 bar is not met.
conditioned_result: CLEARED. Mutating the population's current best genotype and measuring the fitness-effect distribution against the UPCOMING environment predicted whether environmental variability subsequently helped or hurt at r-squared 0.502, p 0.0067. The matched current-state variable, cross-environment fitness correlation of the same populations, gave r-squared 0.089, p 0.279, not significant.
reconstruction_feasibility: LIKELY UNNECESSARY. Code and data both survive. The cheapest available strengthening is a re-analysis, not a reconstruction.
confounds: the version read is the preprint, not the copy-edited PNAS text; check for methods changes
the H3-grade result rests on 15 data points, one per landscape pair
two outlier rules (50 and 70) were explicitly excluded from that regression, so the effect is real but fragile
evidence_tier: HCR01_LANE_FULL_TEXT, quotes and numbers extracted from the retrieved PDF
H_level_note: The only VERIFIED H3 found anywhere in this pass. It is the literal criterion HC-T01 failed: an accessibility-shaped variable outpredicting a matched current-state fitness variable.
relation_to_HC_T01: SUPERSEDES HC-T01 on the exact axis HC-T01 failed, in a machinery-matched substrate. Highest-priority specimen in the programme.

source: Kounios et al., arXiv 1612.05955; PDF held at ergon/kouvaris2017/original/arxiv_1612.05955_kounios_evolvability.pdf and READ DIRECTLY BY THIS SEAT to resolve a conflict between two lanes
substrate: gene regulatory network, 16 real genes, recurrent development
conflict_resolved: Two lanes disagreed. The Ergon lane reported the basin detector measured in a single unablated condition. An HC-R01 lane reported a frozen-depth sub-analysis reaching H4. THIS SEAT READ THE PAPER AND THE ERGON LANE IS CORRECT.
resolution_evidence: Figures 4 and 5, the freeze experiment: G-P maps are frozen at episodes 800 and 1600 (2000 and 4000 in fig 5) alongside a one-to-one map, 1000 G vectors are randomly initialised and microevolved for 40000 generations under each. The reported outcome is MEDIAN FITNESS TRAJECTORIES and endpoint fitness histograms. No accessibility distribution is measured inside the freeze experiment.

Figure 8, the basin detector: the caption states 'we make G equal to the target phenotype of the consistent constraints problem, and evolve only the regulatory interactions under natural selection for 1600 evolutionary episodes'. Basin measured by sampling 10000 G vectors against maps from the end of every episode. ONE condition. No arms, no ablation.
machinery_class_matched: SPLIT. The headline one-to-one versus GRN ablation is NOT matched and shares HC-T01's exact defect. The 800-versus-1600 frozen-map comparison IS matched: both are evolved GRNs differing only in accumulated history.
future_distribution_measured: YES but in the wrong experiment. Longitudinal, global (pre-image size), single condition.
subsequent_acquisition_measured: YES but in the wrong experiment. Fitness trajectories under frozen maps of differing depth.
surviving_artifacts: arXiv PDF and source tarball held locally; author code exists under handle variants per the Ergon lane
reconstruction_feasibility: HIGH AND CHEAP. The frozen maps are static objects and the model is small.
confounds: the headline ablation replicates HC-T01's machinery-presence confound rather than curing it
H_level: H1 for the headline ablation; H1 for the frozen-depth arms (organisation differs, acquisition measured, NO accessibility measurement); the fig-8 detector sits off the scale because it has no contrast
H_level_note: NOT H4. The claim that it reaches H4 does not survive reading the figure captions.
relation_to_HC_T01: THE SAME MISSING CELL, IN A SECOND PAPER, FOUR MONTHS EARLIER. Kounios 2016 holds a longitudinal accessibility detector in one experiment and machinery-MATCHED history arms with an acquisition outcome in another, and never composes them. That is precisely Toussaint's structural failure, and finding it twice independently makes it a property of the field rather than of one author.
why_this_matters_most: Because the 800-versus-1600 frozen-map arms are machinery-matched, running the existing basin detector, or better a local one-step detector, across those frozen maps would be a machinery-matched H2 test that directly attacks the confound that downgraded HC-T01. The maps are frozen and static, so the compute is trivial.

source: Kouvaris, Clune, Kounios, Brede, Watson, 'How evolution learns to generalise', PLOS Comput Biol 13(4):e1005358
substrate: non-linear recurrent GRN, embryonic pattern developed to adult phenotype
present_state_matching_available: PARTIAL. All conditions start from identical random distributions, but the arms differ by design in their selective cost function, so fitness at a later comparison point is not pre-matched.
machinery_note: Every condition uses the identical GRN topology and developmental dynamics; only the cost term in the fitness function differs. This paper does NOT share HC-T01's confound.
future_distribution_how: 5000 embryonic genotypes drawn by Sobol sequence over the hypercube, developed and categorised by resulting adult phenotype. GLOBAL, an explicit drift approximation, not a one-step offspring neighbourhood.
causal_intervention: PARTIAL. Regularisation strength and target noise are causal manipulations of the SELECTIVE REGIME, not an ablation of an already-evolved organisation.
conditioned_note: UNCONFIRMED whether the distribution sampling was done on genotypes matched for fitness across conditions. This is the open question that decides whether it clears H3.
surviving_artifacts: paper states 'No data sets are associated with this publication'. Three author repositories nonetheless exist per the Ergon lane, and one contains an unreported one-step detector.
confounds: global rather than local detector
selective-regime differences make 'matched present state' imprecise
relation_to_HC_T01: machinery-matched, which HC-T01 is not; but global detector and selection-side intervention, where HC-T01 is local and operator-side. The two are complementary rather than competing.

source: Kashtan and Alon 2005 PNAS 102(39):13773-8; Kashtan, Noor and Alon 2007 PNAS 104(34):13711-6; Kashtan, Mayo, Kalisky and Alon 2009 PLOS Comput Biol 5(4):e1000355
substrate: Boolean logic-circuit genomes and feed-forward neural networks; the 2009 paper is a deterministic analytical matrix model
present_state_matching_available: UNCLEAR. The 2005 paper reports comparable final circuit size and fitness under fixed versus varying goals, for example 11 versus 10 gates, but does not pre-register or test a fitness match at a defined comparison point.
machinery_note: identical genotype representation and identical mutation and crossover operators available to both arms. On this axis the MVG line is clean.
future_distribution_how: NEVER. No sampling or enumeration of the offspring distribution reachable from a matched genotype. The dependent variable throughout is time-to-goal.
surviving_artifacts: none located; no author repository found
reconstruction_feasibility: MODERATE, but see the replication caveat
confounds: modularity is the DEPENDENT variable here, not a controlled covariate

A DOCUMENTED REPLICATION FAILURE EXISTS: an AI Safety Camp 2022 team reimplementing the retina task reported 'non-modular messes both for fixed goals and Modularly Varying Goals across a wide range of experimental parameters', i.e. the base modularity effect did not reproduce at all. The authors themselves flag two live hypotheses and did not resolve which.
the 2009 analytical model is deterministic, so a reachable-state distribution is not a meaningful construct in it
evidence_tier: HCR01_LANE_FULL_TEXT for all three papers and for the replication attempt
H_level_note: Internal structure clearly differs by history and acquisition is measured, but no accessibility distribution was ever measured in any paper of the line. Priority A of the directive is therefore WEAK, and weakened further by the replication failure.
relation_to_HC_T01: machinery-matched but detector-free. It is the mirror image of Toussaint, who had the detector and the operator ablation but no matched machinery.
